correctness.rationale: Parseval leaves exactly one non-diagonal triple-sum collision. Phase alignment, the exact two-term boundary maximum \(5/2\), and the interior witness \(11/3\) reduce the problem to an interior two-variable stationary system. Exact polynomial division and substitution reduce every interior critical point to roots of \(P\); Sturm isolation shows two positive roots but only one gives positive \(u\). Hence the admissible stationary point is unique and is the global maximizer. The packaged checker replays the elimination and root isolation with exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: The support \(\{0,1,3\}\) is the canonical first resonant trinomial and the classical Hardy--Littlewood support. Its sixth moment is the first even moment sensitive to the resonance. Computing the exact arbitrary-amplitude \(L^6/L^2\) norm and complete extremizer orbit closes a natural optimization gap left by the phase-only formula and shows structurally that resonance shifts the maximizing amplitudes away from equality.
